questions.q: Opening balance is $2,000, cash inflows $5,000 and cash outflows $7,500. What is the closing balance?
questions.why: Closing balance = opening + net cash flow = 2,000 + (5,000 − 7,500) = −500.

questions.q: Which is the most suitable source of finance to buy a new factory building?
questions.why: Long-term assets need long-term finance; the others are short-term sources.

questions.q: Which source of finance is NOT available to a sole trader?
questions.why: Only limited companies can issue shares.

questions.q: Explain why a profitable business can still run out of cash.
questions.model: Sales may be made on credit, so cash from customers arrives later, while suppliers and wages must be paid now; outflows come before inflows.
points: credit sales / time lag before cash is received
payments (outflows) must be made before cash comes in
